definitions.interval: both endpoints valid and available by window end; gaps/tail are unknown; no extrapolation
definitions.eye_ratio: threshold-based bilateral closed time / valid eye time; not standardized PERCLOS
definitions.events: candidate count by available_at_s in [start,end); flags excluded
definitions.longest: strict observed CLOSED interval inside window; lower bound
definitions.overlap: mouth OPEN is a proxy, not a verified yawn label
definitions.ear: continuous bilateral valid geometry; includes state UNKNOWN if ears valid; time-weighted left-endpoint values
definitions.ear_normalization: EAR / preceding completed open-eye baseline per eye; no clipping; missing baseline stays null
definitions.ear_p10: inverse time-weighted CDF at .10; not a diagnosis or threshold

training: labels intentionally blank; split by subject/video before windowing; do not randomly split overlapping windows
